hypotheses.reason: Use the inclusive threshold established by the first hypothesis, but express the result as selection instead of an explicit bitwise mask. Canonical if-conversion can then allocate the carry-chain mask to r5 and the decrement to r0, matching retail.

semantics_check.argument: For timer <= 0 both produce zero; for timer == 1 decrement is already zero; for timer > 1 both produce timer - 1. No int overflow is possible for a signed short input.
